set.body: Expose CPCA through MultivarPlan without leaking formulas, dataset metadata, or scheduler concerns into multivar. Acceptance: unresolved CPCA constraint specs are distinct from resolved CpcaConstraint values; MultivarEstimator.Cpca and FitArtifact.CpcaArtifact integrate with LocalMultivarExecutor using ROI-local column spaces; validation catches metric, constraint, and block-rank shape errors before execution where possible; formula/model-matrix support remains in higher adapters; focused multivar JVM and JS tests pass.
set.title: Epic: CPCA planner and adapter layer
